summary: Master advanced facilitation and workshop design in 5 days. Gain tools, templates, and scripts to lead high-impact sessions. Enroll now for expert training.
lede: Facilitation training helps senior professionals plan and lead high-stakes group sessions through structured workshop design. They practice diagnosing group readiness, building agendas with timing buffers, guiding divergent and convergent activities, and managing participation in hybrid or virtual settings. The syllabus also covers conflict-resolution techniques, digital collaboration and voting, and translating session outputs into roadmaps and post-workshop plans.
audienceIntro: This advanced course is designed for senior professionals who lead high-stakes sessions, drive innovation, and manage complex group dynamics in hybrid or remote environments.

prerequisites: Prerequisites: This advanced course requires at least 3 years of professional experience leading meetings, workshops, or training sessions. Participants must have a working understanding of group dynamics and basic facilitation concepts (e.g., divergent vs. convergent thinking). No coding or programming skills are required. Participants must bring a laptop for digital design exercises (Miro, Butter, or Lucid) and be prepared to engage in live, high-intensity role-play simulations. Advanced concepts are taught at the operational application level (how to commission and execute) and hands-on implementation level (building your own scripts and templates).
